definition: An open-ended embodied agent with large language models, demonstrating autonomous skill discovery and continuous learning (most notably within the game Minecraft).
details: An open-ended embodied agent with large language models, demonstrating autonomous skill discovery and continuous learning (most notably within the game Minecraft).

explainer.lead: Voyager is an agent that pairs a large language model with an embodied environment to discover skills and keep learning without human scripting. It matters because it shows open-ended, self-directed skill acquisition is possible in a complex world.

tiers.eli5: It is like a robot player that teaches itself new moves in a game, keeps a notebook of what worked, and builds on those tricks instead of starting over.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use it as a pattern for combining LLM-driven planning with a growing skill library and iterative self-improvement. A pitfall is that discovered skills may be brittle or environment-specific, so reuse needs verification.
tiers.paperLevel: Formally, an open-ended embodied agent built on large language models that performs autonomous skill discovery and continuous learning; demonstrated most notably within Minecraft.

explainer.example: In Minecraft, the agent explores, writes new behaviors into its skill library, and later composes those learned skills to tackle harder tasks.
